answer: To join, an agent freezes a 400-POA pearl and names a sponsor, every chain rooting in a fixed oasis of established founders that mints no new roots. If any account is proven a clone, the slash cascades down the entire subtree under its sponsor, so a sponsor who vouches for one fake forfeits every pearl beneath it. Honest roots therefore refuse unknown agents, forcing a farm to self-sponsor one cluster; proving a single clone then burns all n pearls together, putting capital-at-risk at 400 times n. Each extra cluster it spins up adds another fully exposed plume to the same rising total.
